Question B-001-016-006.

Why the correct answer is right: The 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz band is the bank's special band with a maximum allowed bandwidth below 6 kHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "18.068 MHz to 18.168 MHz": This range falls within the broader 7 MHz to 25 MHz group whose general bandwidth limit is 6 kHz, not less than 6 kHz.
- sourceIndex 2: "24.890 MHz to 24.990 MHz": This range is also inside the 7 MHz to 25 MHz group, so the general 6 kHz HF-group limit applies rather than the special below-6-kHz rule.
- sourceIndex 3: "1.800 MHz to 2.000 MHz": This is the 160-metre band range named elsewhere in the bank; it is not the 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz narrow-band exception.
